title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.14205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Load imbalance poses a major bottleneck to the efficiency of expert parallelism in distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The most heavily loaded rank stalls global execution due to skewed routing distributions, directly increasing latency. While offline expert placement can alleviate persistent imbalance, practical multi-task serving workloads exhibit layer- and batch-dependent routing dynamics, making online load balancing indispensable. translated_title: FreeBalance：通过残差工作负载预测实现路由前的在线MoE负载均衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14205v1 公告类型：新 摘要：负载不均衡是混合专家（MoE）模型分布式推理中专家并行效率的主要瓶颈。由于路由分布倾斜，负载最重的排名会阻塞全局执行，直接增加延迟。虽然离线专家放置可以缓解持续性的不均衡，但实际的多任务服务工作负载表现出层和批次相关的路由动态，使得在线负载均衡必不可少。现有方法依赖于每个MoE路由器后收集的路由统计信息，要求专家权重加载或迁移仅在路由决策可用后开始，从而将迁移开销置于推理关键路径上。在这项工作中，我们观察到，如果能够提前准确预测路由分布，在线均衡可以在目标路由（如注意力）之前的计算中大部分重叠。因此，我们提出FreeBalance，一种通过残差工作负载预测实现路由前在线负载均衡的方法。
tldr: FreeBalance通过提前预测路由分布，将在线负载均衡与计算重叠，避免了迁移开销进入推理关键路径，从而显著提升MoE模型分布式推理效率。
en_tdlr: FreeBalance overlaps online load balancing with computation by predicting routing distributions in advance, avoiding migration overhead on the inference critical path, thereby significantly improving the efficiency of distributed MoE inference.
